title: The render ask was minted as the FULL 21GiB whenever the card was occupied, poisoning the queued record against the free reading it is later judged by
evidence:
The adaptive-fit ask (095ba28, 2026-09-21) budgeted the render reservation against live free memory, but kept the FULL 21GiB ask whenever the reduced ask fell below the floor. The ask is not a per-tick decision: it is PERSISTED in the queue record (jobs/<id>.json -> vram_gb) and re-checked by the scheduler's `poll` at CLAIM time against a DIFFERENT free reading -- the card as it is once the current occupant has released. So a full ask minted while another project holds the card is a self-inflicted `vram_insufficient` for the entire life of that record.

Measured 2026-09-21 (read-only): the 08:03:56 tick ran `ensure` while prx-tg-pixel-posttrain-v3 held 16GiB, and `bin/comfyui_harness.sh plan 8192` returns ask=21GiB -- the harness log confirms the request: "ensure: requesting claim comfyui-1789992236-4075726-1 (vram 21GB, duration 9h)", and the queue record carries vram_gb 21.0. The refusal that record will earn the moment the occupant releases is the one already in the same log from the 01:04-06:05 ticks: "ensure: why -- free=18949MiB vs requested 21GiB; holders: ... labeler_spa.py 4588 MiB". The entry is then given up at the FIFO head ("gave up the FIFO head (vram_insufficient) so a job behind us can take the card") and re-requested on the NEXT tick, so every occurrence costs a whole render window -- the exact starvation the adaptive-fit fix was meant to end.

FIX (commit 81e8c4a): below the floor, carry the FLOOR instead of the full ask, in both surfaces (bin/comfyui_harness.sh vram_ask_for_free + bin/tc_ops.py adaptive_ask_gb, whose agreement the selftest cross-checks against the harness's own `plan` output). No invariant changes: `poll` still refuses anything below the ask, so "nothing is attempted below the floor" holds exactly as before; the record is simply claimable at the floor the moment the card frees to it.

VERIFIED (no GPU, no claim): plan 8192 -> 16GiB (was 21), 16384 -> 16GiB (was 21), 18939 -> 17GiB unchanged, 24564 -> 21GiB unchanged; selftest 224 assertions / 0 failures; NEGATIVE CONTROL -- restoring `echo "$full"` in the harness fails harness-plan-matches-mirror[8192] and [16384] (224 assertions, 2 failures), then restored.

notes.note: FIXED IN-REPO (commit 81e8c4a): below the floor the ask now carries the FLOOR (16GiB), not the full 21GiB, in bin/comfyui_harness.sh (vram_ask_for_free) and its mirrored bin/tc_ops.py adaptive_ask_gb. Rationale: the ask is persisted in the queue record and re-checked at CLAIM time against the free reading the card will have once the occupant releases, so a full ask minted under occupancy is a self-inflicted vram_insufficient for the life of the record -- costing a render window per occurrence (the 08:03:56 record comfyui-1789992236-4075726-1 asks 21.0GB while free will be ~18.9GiB). VERIFIED: plan 8192/16384 -> 16GiB (was 21GiB), 18939 -> 17GiB and 24564 -> 21GiB unchanged; selftest 224 assertions / 0 failures; NEGATIVE CONTROL -- restoring echo "$full" fails harness-plan-matches-mirror[8192] and [16384] (2 failures), then restored. Nothing was claimed, launched or released: the fix is decision logic only, exercised through the harness plan dry-run.
